summary: Retry after a failed engine install can never succeed on Linux/macOS. uv venv exits 2 with "A virtual environment already exists at: comfy-venv" - it refuses ANY existing venv, complete or not - so the first attempt past step 1 poisons every later one and the Installation Failed dialog offers a Retry that is guaranteed to fail. Root cause is an asymmetry in _provisionUvEngine: step 0b clears a stale ComfyUI workspace, its sibling comfy-venv had no guard. Fixed by passing --clear. Found live after a mid-install thermal shutdown.

LIVE-VERIFIED on Linux. Deliberate repro - Install, Ctrl+C once comfy-install started, relaunch, Install again. Step 1 now logs "Creating virtual environment with seed packages at: comfy-venv" and "+ pip==26.2" instead of exit 2 / "A virtual environment already exists", and step 2 installed comfy-cli 48 packages. uv venv --clear closes this card. The SAME retry then failed at step 3 on a different root cause - comfy install refuses an existing valid clone - filed as MPI-411; that does not reopen this one.
doing -> done (complete). Live-verified on Linux 2026-07-30 (uv venv --clear rebuilt an existing venv).
